description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Wheel of Fortune by paying {2}{R}, causing each player to discard their hand, and causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
